# Example 1: Edge count

```{r edge-example}

population <- 100
covPattern <- rep(0L, population)

# Run CCMnet MCMC
fit <- CCM_fit(
  Network_stats = list("Edge"),
  Prob_Distr = list("NP"),
  Prob_Distr_Params = list(
    dnbinom(0:choose(100,2), size = 1.017340, mu = 6.192894)
  ),
  population = population,
  covPattern = covPattern
)

# Add theoretical distribution
fit <- CCM_theoretical_check(fit,
                             n_sim = nrow(fit$mcmc_stats))

# Plots
plot(fit, stats = "edges", type = "hist")
plot(fit, stats = "edges", type = "density")
plot(fit, stats = "edges", type = "density", include_theoretical = TRUE)
CCM_traceplot(fit, stats = "edges")
```

# Example 2: Degree distribution

```{r degree-example}
population <- 100
covPattern <- rep(0L, population)

# Network model
Network_stats <- list("Degree")
Prob_Distr <- list("Multinomial_Poisson")
Prob_Distr_Params <- list(
  population,  
  dnbinom(0:(population-1), size = 1.017340, mu = 6.192894)
)

# MCMC parameters
samplesize <- 1000L
burnin <- 200000L
interval <- 1000L

# Run CCMnet MCMC
fit <- CCM_fit(
  Network_stats = Network_stats,
  Prob_Distr = Prob_Distr,
  Prob_Distr_Params = Prob_Distr_Params,
  population = as.integer(population),
  covPattern = as.integer(covPattern)
)

# Add theoretical distribution
fit <- CCM_theoretical_check(fit)

# Plots for degrees 0-9
plot(fit, stats = paste0("deg", 0:9), type = "density")
plot(fit, stats = paste0("deg", 0:9), type = "density", include_theoretical = TRUE)
CCM_traceplot(fit, stats = paste0("deg", 0:9))
```

# Example 3: Mixing matrix distribution

```{r mixing-example}
population <- 100
covPattern <- c(rep(0L, population/2), rep(1L, population/2))

Network_stats <- list("Mixing")
Prob_Distr <- list("Multinomial_Poisson")
Prob_Distr_Params <- list(
  20,           # mean number of mixing edges
  c(.3, .6, .1) # probabilities for M11, M21, M22
)

# Run CCMnet MCMC
fit <- CCM_fit(
  Network_stats = Network_stats,
  Prob_Distr = Prob_Distr,
  Prob_Distr_Params = Prob_Distr_Params,
  population = population,
  covPattern = covPattern  # optional
)

# Add theoretical distribution
fit <- CCM_theoretical_check(fit)

# Plot MCMC + theoretical
plot(fit, stats = c("M11","M21","M22"), type = "density", include_theoretical = TRUE)
```
